title: Command Palette: Add starred dashboards section
body: **What is this feature?** Adds a dedicated **Starred dashboards** section to the command palette. Signed-in users can open the command palette and jump directly to their starred dashboards. **Why do we need this feature?** Favorite dashboards should be reachable from anywhere in Grafana without first navigating to dashboard browse or running a dashboard search. **Who is this feature for?** Grafana users who rely on starred dashboards as their primary/favorite dashboard shortcuts. **Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**: N/A **Special notes for your reviewer:** Please check that: - [x] It works as expected from a user's perspective. - [x] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feature toggle. (N/A: this extends existing command palette behavior.) - [x] The docs are updated, and if this is a notable improvement, it's added to What's New. (N/A: small discoverability improvement to existing command palette behavior.) **Testing** - `yarn jest --no-watch public/app/features/commandPalette/actions/dashboardActions.test.ts` - `yarn jest --no-watch public/app/features/commandPalette/CommandPalette.test.tsx` - Manual verification with a starred demo dashboard: - Opened the command palette. - Confirmed the **Starred dashboards** section appears. - Selected the starred dashboard and confirmed navigation. **Demo**
